contact_information.founder_name: Divya Krishna R, Sumalata Kamat, Karthik. C

company_purpose.one_liner: Drive value with Data from a conversation

problem.description: The AI Crisis and State of Enterprise AI Adoption. Organizations depend on a centralized data team, making the pipeline fragile.
problem.validation_data: 90% AI Projects Fail, 76% Decisions made through Spreadsheets, 68% Data is not used and remains in data silos, 500% Increase in volume of data generated over the past decade.
problem.context: This is because of High cost of data analytics, Dependency on Manual expertise, Fragmented data pipelines. Diverse types of Data Generated across multiple systems lead to Fragmented Supply chain, Talent Shortage, Unsystematic Processes, Security & Privacy Risks, Inconsistent Datasets, and Brittle Systems.

solution.product_description: Sia brings a full data team to everyone across the organization through a Simple Chat Interface
solution.key_features: Recommender Engine, Pattern discovery, Auto Visualizations, Rapid Deployment, Data quality Reports, No-code model building, Instant Insights, Develop Data Summaries, Build context of Data.
solution.value_proposition: Democratization of AI & Data, Context aware insights, Minimized bottlenecks.
solution.how_it_works: Sia connects fragmented data systems in businesses to provide various data analytics functionalities.

product.detailed_features: Recommender Engine, Pattern discovery, Auto Visualizations, Rapid Deployment, Data quality Reports, No-code model building, Instant Insights, Develop Data Summaries, Build context of Data.
product.unique_selling_points: Agentic AI for Data Analytics, Simple Chat Interface, Democratization of AI & Data, Context aware insights, Minimized bottlenecks.
product.user_experience_overview: Accessed through a simple chat interface.

traction_and_validation.user_or_customer_growth: Taking signups and interest from customers (as of 2024, first version deployment).
